day.headline: A Rooster day — Ox and Snake are in step.

reasons: Ox and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the street with no name you use
signs.message: Name that little cut-through yourself today. Use it in the chat.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Rain's on the app, not on your street. Go out anyway.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Something renews this week. Handle it today, on your terms.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: You made that call weeks ago. Say it where people hear.

reasons: Rabbit opposes Rooster — a day to take slowly
signs.motif: an idea that needs one more piece
signs.message: One piece missing and you know which. Go find it today.

reasons: Goat sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: That intro actually landed. Thank whoever made it, one line.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Those peaches are a day from mush. Eat them over the sink.

reasons: Dragon pairs with Rooster — a harmonious day
signs.motif: a message arriving at the right moment
signs.message: That text landed exactly when you needed it. Tell them so.

reasons: Pig sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Summer's still hanging front and center. Shove it back, sort it later.

reasons: Snake and Rooster share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: That shoulder's tight again. Keep everything low today, no reaching overhead.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Rooster — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the good coat for no occasion
signs.message: The nice coat keeps. Nothing tonight deserves it, wear the soft one.

reasons: Rooster's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Nothing to shave time off today. Let the shortcut rest.
